'''Daughter''' can refer to the following:

==Titles and groups==
* [[Daughter-Heir]] - the title of the heir to the [[Lion Throne]] of [[Andor]].
* [[Daughter of the Night]] - the meaning of Lanfear in the [[Old Tongue]].
* [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] - the title of the heir to the [[Crystal Throne]] of [[Seanchan]].
* [[Daughters of Silence]] - a group of [[channelers]] in {{ne|794}}.

==Others==
* [[Diadem of the Daughter-Heir]] - the ceremonial crown worn by the Daughter-Heir of Andor.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 36|The Daughter of the Night]]'' - the thirty-sixth chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* The word is also used by the [[Amyrlin Seat]] when referring to other [[Aes Sedai]] or women of high station.
* ''ay'', ''la'', and ''sur'' - all Old Tongue words meaning daughter, the first meaning "daughter of."
